title: aster ascendens var. denudatus
intro: Aster ascendens var. denudatus, commonly known as Naked White Aster, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Aster ascendens var. denudatus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections, as well as protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects.
